notes: BENCH-5 perf ratchet thresholds — consumed by scripts/check_perf_ratchet.py.
Thresholds live HERE (not in the script) so tightening/loosening is an explicit
reviewed commit, never an in-run adjustment (metrics-contract.md section 13).
The ratchet is deliberately looser than the contract gates (regression ALARM during
the climb to parity, not a parity gate): it fails on cliffs, not on parity misses.
The regression baseline is NOT stored here: it is derived as the best committed
EVIDENCE row per metric from ratchet/ledger.jsonl (headline_eligible only, same
host_arch). LOADED/dirty/smoke rows never become baselines. MISMATCH != 0 and
are unconditional rejects regardless of any threshold — not ratchetable.
Noise floor rationale (contract section 2): runtime 10% > the max(5%, 2x spread)
significance floor on a quiet machine; compile 25% catches the popcnt-canary class
(~9x) and the greedy-interferes class while tolerating verdict-cache variance.
